I have farmed beans on this plot for many years using seed saved from my own harvest, and I trust what has always fed my family. I will spread manure from our goats and chickens to help the soil, but chemical fertilizer and pesticides are too expensive and difficult to find in our area. We depend entirely on the June rains, so I do not irrigate; my children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without paying for outside workers.
